reviews.title: One Device Login = Locked Out Everywhere Else
reviews.text:
The Crunch app is incredibly frustrating. If you log in from your computer or iPad, you apparently can’t log back in from your phone. Why?! I don’t always have access to my iPad or a computer, yet I’m expected to use those devices to sign up for classes.  And here’s the biggest problem: you only have about 60 seconds to grab a spot before a class fills up! So if I happen to be away from my iPad or computer when registration opens, I’m out of luck.
The ONLY reason I logged in on my iPad in the first place was because the app required an update before it would let me log in. Now that I’ve done that, I’m essentially locked out of using the app on my phone.  A gym app should make it easier to access classes, not prevent you from accessing them on the device you actually have with you. This needs to be fixed. Let me log in and use the app on all of my devices or computer!

It should have the ability to create recipes, log a meal that was eaten the previous day (which is fantastic for food prep folks), monitor net carbs, grams of fiber, sodium, etc., and also show trending for things like calorie deficit. 

I think the workout log should allow for entering a workout like walking or whatever activities that occur on days off from the gym. It helps to give the user a complete picture of their movement and activity.

Don’t make things easier for the company, make it easier for the client. Crunch Allen needs a hot yoga space. All crunch’s need infrared light therapy. Totally worth paying for it.

reviews.title: Only good for booking classes—everything else is abysmal
reviews.text:
This app is an absolute nightmare to navigate. The only useful feature it has is letting you schedule a class—beyond that, it’s basically useless.

Instead of being a proper native app, it’s just a clunky hybrid wrapper for web pages that barely load. The built-in AI agent is unhelpful and feels like a dead end designed to keep you from getting real support. Good luck if you actually need to contact your home gym: finding a basic phone number or email address for your local club is next to impossible.

Unless you strictly need to get on the schedule for a specific class, this app is a complete failure.
